figure_1.analytical_question: How does one frozen corpus support three bounded downstream tasks without treating BGE-M3 as a universal method?
figure_1.takeaway: Shared evidence controls precede three task-specific branches; BGE-M3 is evaluated only in retrieval, while NER and written rhyme use their own methods and claim boundaries.
figure_1.data_sufficiency: Frozen corpus counts and method definitions are available in public audit and method contracts.
figure_1.palette_policy: three branch roots plus neutrals; labels and position provide redundant distinction

figure_2.analytical_question: Does untuned dense-lexical fusion improve held-out-song source-credit-label repertoire retrieval over each strict single representation?
figure_2.takeaway: Fusion is higher than BGE-M3 and character TF-IDF on every requested macro metric; all paired 5,000-replicate intervals are above zero.
figure_2.family: faceted dot-and-interval benchmark with paired-delta panel
figure_2.data_sufficiency: 15 primary benchmark rows and 10 paired contrasts, 5,455 queries across 204 labels.
figure_2.palette_policy: hard two-root cap plus neutrals; marker shape/fill redundantly distinguishes systems and contrasts

figure_3.analytical_question: What cultural-reference evidence remains after shared-text exclusion, uncertainty control, and BH-FDR screening?
figure_3.takeaway: Evidence controls reduce a broad candidate inventory to 22 provisional entities, six source-label-to-place enrichments, and four same-song co-mentions; all remain lyric-reference claims rather than biographical or social claims.
figure_3.family: stage-progression evidence controls plus log-scale forest plot and compact co-mention dot bars
figure_3.data_sufficiency: Six released label-to-PLACE links with conservative intervals and four released co-mentions over 5,681 eligible song units; no completed human gold.
figure_3.palette_policy: hard two-root cap plus neutrals; marker shape, fill, labels, and panel position provide non-colour distinction

figure_4.analytical_question: How accurately can strict written line-ending families be predicted, where does the task remain difficult, and does adding source-credit labels help?
figure_4.takeaway: Context models improve ranking, but family switches remain difficult and the source-credit-label feature has no supported held-out benefit.
figure_4.family: small-multiple dot-and-interval benchmark plus grouped transition bars
figure_4.data_sufficiency: Five models on 34,395 leakage-safe events in 787 held-out songs; two transition strata and four paired label-ablation contrasts.
figure_4.palette_policy: hard two-root cap plus neutrals; open/filled markers and hatching provide non-colour distinction
